attr.title: Chaotix Recompiled
attr.desc: Native static recompilation of Knuckles' Chaotix for KNULLI.
attr.inst: You must provide your own legally obtained Knuckles' Chaotix (Japan, USA) ROM. Place it at /roms/ports/ROM/chaotix.32x. The first launch verifies and installs the ROM. No ROM or BIOS is included.
